simple.meaning: צָעִיף (tsâʻîyph) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a veil.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 24:65. The surrounding context includes kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צָעִיף (H6809) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.full: H6809. tsaiph צָעִיף noun [masculine] wrapper, shawl, or veil ; — absolute ׳צ Gen 24:65 ; 38:14 ; suffix צְעִיפָהּ 38:19 (all J). צַעֲצֻעִים see צוע .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to wrap over ;

occurrences.englishText: She said to the servant, “Who is the man who is walking in the field to meet us?”

She took off the garments of her widowhood, and covered herself with her veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in the gate of Enaim, which is on the way to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was grown up, and she wasn’t given to him as a wife.
She arose, and went away, and put off her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.
